mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Sort the object list of a transport task and merge its duplicate entries.

description: Sorts the object list of the transport task named by transport_number and merges its duplicate entries. Required: transport_number* (a task). A task holding the same entry twice refuses removing an entry until this has run. Response: JSON — acceptance only; a re-read of the task's objects (object_type TRANSPORT) confirms it. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

transport_number.description: Number of the transport task to sort and compress.

name: HandlerTransportSortAndCompress
